text:
Stop forcing partnerships that drain you.

You're in a group that doesn't fit. Maybe you're the smartest one. Maybe they won't commit. Maybe there's constant tension in every meeting.

You stay anyway because leaving feels like failure.

It's the opposite.

A mastermind only works when members operate in genuine harmony. Friction doesn't decrease power. It kills it. Most groups fail on this one thing alone.

You already know who doesn't belong.

Genius without alignment always loses to average with unity.
caption:
Most groups are one person away from being unstoppable.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
